cinit.title: Disable cloud-init
cinit.note: Stops cloud-init from reclaiming your network config on the next boot. Writes the disable flag, masks the four units, pins network config off. Elevates through sudo on its own when it is not run as root.
cinit.target: Debian · Ubuntu · any systemd host with /etc/cloud

sudo.title: Install sudo
sudo.note: Installs sudo on a minimal box and puts your account in the admin group. Picks the user from the argument, then the login name, then the only regular account it finds — and refuses to guess when several exist. Must be started as root: sudo is the thing that is missing.
